full_judgment: 32. Exhibit 3 is Judgment and Decree passed in Title Suit No. 55 of 1973 of Fifth Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka wherein plaintiff's vendor's father Afsaruddin's title has been declared against heirs of Ayetunnessa Bibi whose name stood wrongly recorded in the State Acquisition Record of Right. In that Title Suit present defendant-opposite party Government of The People's Republic of Bangladesh had been defendant No. 15. Exhibit-4 is a Judgment passed by a Division Bench of High Court Division in Appeal from Original Decree No. 60 of 1975 wherein Judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No. 55 of 1973 had been maintained by the High Court Division on dismissing First Appeal filed by defendants of that Title suit. Defendant-opposite party is very much bound by said Decree. Exhibit 5 is deed of conveyance executed by Mobarak Mia, PW 2 Vendor and owner of suit property in favour of plaintiff. Exhibit 6 a Duplicate Carbon Receipt in respect of mutation and sub-division of holding in the name of vendor PW 2. The order of mutation and separation of holding in the name of vendor PW 2 is dated 29-11-1992. Exhibit Kha is a Rent Receipt showing payment of rent by Vendor PW 2. Rent Receipt is dated 16-8-1992. Exhibit 7(Ka) is Duplicate Carbon Receipt showing mutation and division of holding in the name of plaintiff. Exhibit 7 is Rent Receipt manifesting payment of rent by plaintiff to Tahsil office, Tejgaon Circle, Dhaka. Exhibit 7 (kha) is Mutated Khatian in the name of plaintiff and the order of mutation and separation of holding is dated 15-12-1994. Exhibit Nos. 8 and 9 are two petitions addressed to Chairman, Rajdhani Unnayan Kartripakha praying for release of suit property. Exhibit 10 is a letter contained in Memo No. Sha-8/Raj /8/94 /8 dated 10-1-96 sent by Senior Assistant Secretary of Works and Housing to the Chairman, Rajdhani Unnayan Kartripakha for consideration of prayer filed by Vendor PW 2 for release of suit property. Exhibit 12 is a document showing that in the Award prepared in Land Acquisition Case No. 2 of 1966-67 the name of Vendor or the heirs of Afsaruddin did not appear as Awardee. Exhibit Ka is Gazette Notification. Exhibit Ga is defendant's document detailing the names of awardees for properties acquired in Land Acquisition Case.
